subject: Cloud Computing
title: Free Tiers and Credits
description: A quick, practical guide to Free Tiers and Credits.

hook.text: AWS gives you a year of free services. Azure gives you $200 in credits. Google gives $300. The hook is set.

buildup.text: Free tiers let developers experiment without risk. Small workloads can run for free indefinitely.

discovery.text: Startups get even more. AWS Activate, Google for Startups, and Azure credits provide up to $100,000 free.

twist.text: Free tiers create dependency. By the time credits expire, your entire stack is built on that provider.

climax.text: Cloud providers invest billions in free tiers because acquiring a customer today means revenue for years.

punchline.text: Free tiers aren't charity. They're the first hit.

quiz.question: Why do cloud providers offer generous free tiers?
options: To create dependency so customers stay and pay when credits expire
They have unlimited resources and don't need revenue
Government regulations require a free tier for all cloud services

details.summary: Every major cloud provider offers free tiers with limited resources for experimenting, learning, and building prototypes. Startups can often get $5,000 to $100,000 in credits through programs like AWS Activate, Azure for Startups, and Google for Startups Cloud.
details.whyItMatters: Free tiers lower the barrier to learning cloud skills. Startup credits can fund the first year of infrastructure, giving founders runway to build without upfront cloud costs.
takeaways: Free tiers offer limited resources at no cost for learning
Startup programs provide thousands of dollars in cloud credits
Credits expire and convert to paid billing, requiring planning

faq.question: What is included in cloud free tiers?
faq.answer: AWS offers 750 hours per month of t2.micro instances for 12 months plus always-free services like Lambda and DynamoDB. Azure and GCP offer similar. Always-free tiers include limited compute, storage, and serverless invocations that never expire.

faq.question: What happens when free tier credits expire?
faq.answer: Resources automatically convert to standard paid billing. Without billing alerts, you can incur unexpected charges. Set budget alerts immediately when starting, and shut down or delete resources before credits expire if you do not intend to pay.
